candidate_claims.name: rule-set-payload-shuffling-candidate
candidate_claims.proposed_invariant: A producer cannot alter verification outcome or presentation digests by reordering rules in a payload; presentations must sort rules deterministically before hashing.

candidate_claims.name: sealed-receipt-deserialization-candidate
candidate_claims.proposed_invariant: Sealed execution receipts and round records must be write-only on the wire; they must not deserialize untrusted caller bytes into validated receipt objects.
counterexamples: An unsealed diagnostic telemetry packet may deserialize caller diagnostics for logging purposes only.

candidate_claims.name: producer-carrier-self-elevation-candidate

candidate_claims.name: truncating-remainder-confusion-candidate

counterexamples: Hardware register operations may explicitly specify signed two's-complement truncating remainder when modelling C machine instructions.

candidate_claims.name: unanchored-regex-semantic-bleed-candidate

candidate_claims.name: multiformat-receipt-desync-candidate
candidate_claims.proposed_invariant: Dual-format receipts (JSON and Markdown) describing an execution must be emitted in the exact same process run from identical in-memory evidence structures.
counterexamples: A post-hoc renderer may reformat an immutable, digest-verified JSON receipt into HTML/Markdown without re-executing the experiment.

candidate_claims.name: unused-and-unsorted-import-bleed-candidate
candidate_claims.proposed_invariant: All newly written or modified Python modules must maintain zero unused imports (F401), zero unused variables (F841), and strictly sorted import blocks (I001). counterexamples: A package __init__.py explicitly re-exporting public API symbols listed in __all__ or annotated with # noqa: F401 for external consumers.

candidate_claims.name: canned-pilot-theater-candidate
candidate_claims.proposed_invariant: Execution runs claiming live model dispatch or empirical search must not pre-populate result dictionaries, simulate spend, or mock LLM turns without explicit mock environment declaration.
counterexamples: Unit tests explicitly exercising mock adapter playback in declared offline mode.

candidate_claims.name: blanket-suppression-leak-candidate
candidate_claims.proposed_invariant: Static analysis suppressions (ignore_missing_imports, blanket type ignores, bare excepts) must not be applied globally to conceal regressions or circular imports; scoped module overrides must be used instead.
